Daily tee-sheet use against a course capacity schedule

Source: R/capacity.R
daily_utilization.Rd

Compares groups on a tee sheet with the daily supply from course_capacity(). One row is one group at one start. Groups that share a start count as one occupied tee time, and their players add together. A single player on a foursome start occupies the tee time and one player slot.

Usage

daily_utilization(bookings, capacity)

Arguments

bookings

Tee-sheet rows with date, tee_time ("HH:MM" or "HH:MM:SS"), and players.

capacity

A result from course_capacity(), one row per date.

Value

A tibble with one row per scheduled date, including tee_time_occupancy and slot_utilization.

Details

tee_time_occupancy is occupied tee times divided by scheduled tee times. slot_utilization is players divided by player slots. Both are shares. Neither is capped at 1. A day with no scheduled starts has no share, because the denominator is zero. A day in the schedule with no groups is zero use. A group on a date that is not in the schedule is an error.

This is not the Dobson daylight comparison. That file has no tee time and no players per group. Daily rounds stay on utilization_calendar().

Examples

capacity <- course_capacity(
  date = as.Date("2024-06-01"),
  window_start = "07:00",
  window_end = "07:40",
  tee_interval_minutes = 10,
  players_per_start = 4
)
bookings <- data.frame(
  date = as.Date(c("2024-06-01", "2024-06-01", "2024-06-01")),
  tee_time = c("07:00", "07:00", "07:10"),
  players = c(4, 0, 1)
)
daily_utilization(bookings, capacity)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 7
#>   date       tee_times player_slots occupied_tee_times players
#>   <date>         <dbl>        <dbl>              <dbl>   <dbl>
#> 1 2024-06-01         4           16                  2       5
#> # ℹ 2 more variables: tee_time_occupancy <dbl>, slot_utilization <dbl>
